title: Wingfoot Air Express crash

location.name: Chicago Loop, Illinois Trust and Savings Building

summary: The Wingfoot Air Express, a Goodyear FD hydrogen-filled airship, caught fire and crashed into the Illinois Trust and Savings Bank building in Chicago. The hydrogen ignited at 1200 feet altitude over the Chicago Loop. Two crew parachuted safely and one died when his parachute caught fire; the airship's flaming debris fell through the bank's skylight, killing 10 bank employees.
probable_cause: Hydrogen caught fire for unknown reasons

factors.evidence: The airship's flammable hydrogen caught fire for unknown reasons at about 4:55pm
flaming debris falling through to the banking hall below
remains of the blimp struck the bank's skylight

events.text: Hydrogen ignited for unknown reasons at 1200 feet altitude over Chicago Loop
Pilot Jack Boettner and mechanic Harry Wacker parachuted to safety from burning airship
Mechanic Carl Emery Weaver killed when his parachute caught fire; photographer Milton Norton broke both legs on landing and died in hospital
Remains of blimp struck Illinois Trust and Savings Bank skylight at LaSalle and Jackson
Flaming debris fell through skylight to banking hall, killing 10 bank employees
